subject: world_language
concept: Participating in an extended discussion, expressing and defending an opinion with reasons in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B1-B2 'sustained argumentative interaction' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student sequences discussion-turn cards into a coherent extended exchange defending a position
exercise.abstract: Student performs an extended spoken or written discussion defending an opinion with multiple connected reasons

assessment.mastery_threshold: discussion includes at least two connected supporting reasons for the stated opinion
misconception_flags: states an opinion with no supporting reasons, or reasons unconnected to the actual opinion

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
